faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications for the Data Entry Operator position is 29th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the office before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess any graduation degree along with a Government Approved DCA or PGDCA course to be eligible for the Data Entry Operator position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Data Entry Operator post is 40 years as of 1st September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Data Entry Operator position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 14175/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Data Entry Operator job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a walk-in interview is scheduled for 1st October 2026 for the Data Entry Operator position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website for NAM Kerala?
faq.answer: The official website for National Ayush Mission Kerala is www.nam.kerala.gov.in. You can find more information and download forms here.

faq.question: Q8. What documents do I need to attach with my application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of your educational qualification certificates and age proof with the application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Data Entry Operator position is on a contract basis under the National Ayush Mission Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I submit my offline application?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted in person or by post to the office of the District Programme Manager, National Ayush Mission, 5th floor, Arogya Bhavan Building, near Ayurveda College, Thiruvananthapuram.
